hero_intro: Photo edits by abdo. Real portraits, reworked in Photoshop.
statement: Every image here started as a real photo of a real person. I take it into Photoshop and build it into something new.

about_lead: Photo editor and digital artist working in Photoshop.
about_text:
I take photos of people and edit them: retouching, changing the mood, and sometimes building a whole new scene around them.

Each piece is about keeping the person recognizable while making the image feel like more than a photo.
contact_text: Want your photo edited? Send me a message.
